notes: All eight differentiators are shipped and 47 of 51 matrix rows are at parity or better. Missing: reasoning control (V13, in flight) and npm publication (owner action). Partial: no trace viewer; the CLI scaffold cannot be used from npm until the package is published.

Main passes the full local suite after every group of merges (Windows, Node 26): typecheck, lint, 2,907 tests with coverage, fallow, 165 docs snippets and the four Agent Forge checks. The test count fell from 2,947 because the surface cleanup deleted unused modules together with their tests.

ai v7 and zod 4: peers accept ai 4, 6 and 7 and zod 3 or 4. OpenAI, Anthropic and OpenRouter projects are scaffolded on ai 7. Ollama stays on ai 4 in the scaffold; on ai 6/7 it needs zod 4 and has not been tested.

What was verified how: every PR got typecheck and targeted tests after syncing with main, then a full run per group. The Docker sandbox features (container cleanup on cancel, egress through the broker) were tested against a Docker fake only: there is no Docker daemon on the machine.

Breaking or model-visible changes shipped pre-1.0 (all in CHANGELOG with migration notes): removed MemoryManager, ContextBuilder, retry(), data and templates; default channel approver is the user who started the turn; sandboxed commands no longer inherit the host environment; CLI commands reject unknown flags; a tool's own deny beats a permissions allow rule; cancelled tool results use the shared error shape.

Limits left in shipped features: a remote sub-agent that pauses for approval must be approved on the remote agent, then continued by task id (Y7.3). Without tickets: the registry's permission manifest is shown but not enforced; ACP has no file or terminal methods; a pending ask_question in Slack or Discord is lost on restart; sub-agent fingerprints are stored but not compared on resume.
Open problem: the deploy test folder intermittently makes vitest exit at startup when run right after another deploy run; it passes on retry. D2.3 is investigating.
Owner instructions in force: branches are never deleted; CI is not awaited (it pins Node 22, the local runs use Node 26); npm publish and release config are the owner's.
